subject: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery \u2014 security & DPA follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenwell.com>, Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@zenwell.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery — security & DPA follow-up

Hi Samira / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so we have alignment on security/compliance requirements and timelines.

Summary of pain points / goals you shared:
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence for platform controls, and a clear timeline for proof during procurement.
- Audit logs and retention policy: compliance team requires 7 years of searchable audit logs and evidence of immutable storage.
- Data residency & retention: customer data segregation for PHI in AWS us-east-1, with configurable retention policies and secure deletion on contract end.
- DPA negotiation: your legal team will push standard DPA redlines; you asked for a starting redline we can accept.
- Pen-test evidence: you want summary of latest third-party penetration test and remediation timeline.

What Redwood can provide (short):
- SOC 2 report (Type II): we can share our latest report and roadmap for next audit window.
- Audit logging: centralized audit logs stored in immutable S3 with retention controls; we can provide sample log extracts and schema.
- DPA: attached a DPA redline (DPA_redline_v2.docx) that outlines acceptable counterpoints; happy to take specific suggestions from your counsel.
- Pen test: summary report and remediation tracker (pen_test_summary_2026.zip).

Immediate next steps we agreed:
1) I will share: current SOC 2 report, pen-test summary, and a proposed DPA redline by EOD tomorrow (May 21).
2) Samira: share the ZenWell procurement timeline and any milestone dates for security sign-off (approx date and contact for legal).
3) Neha (CC'd) will schedule a short technical follow-up to walk through audit log formats and retention options — suggested 30 minutes.

Questions / open items:
- Do you have any specific retention/encryption standards we should confirm (e.g., KMS/HSM requirements)?
- Any additional compliance frameworks to surface now (HIPAA BAAs, FedRAMP, etc.)?

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachments referenced: SOC2_Report_Q1_2027.pdf (will attach in follow-up)

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenwell.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@zenwell.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery — security & DPA follow-up

Thanks Marissa — this is super helpful and aligns with our notes. A few quick clarifications from our side:

- Timeline: our procurement deadline for vendor security sign-off is June 18. Legal will need the SOC 2 and DPA redline two weeks prior (by June 4) to have time for review.
- Audit logs: we require immutability and WORM-style retention for audit trails; preferred encryption with customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM).
- Pen test: we prefer a pen-test summary plus evidence of fixes (tickets or remediation log).

Tom (cc'd) will coordinate legal side review.

Can you attach the SOC 2 and pen test summary when available? For the DPA, our legal counsel prefers to propose changes rather than accept a vendor redline — we’ll send those comments after we see your starting redline.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to jump on a short call next week if helpful.

Best,
Samira Khan
Director, Security & Privacy | ZenWell Health
samira.khan@zenwell.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@zenwell.com>
Cc: Tom Garcia <tom.garcia@zenwell.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery — security & DPA follow-up

Samira — attaching the documents we discussed. Please see short notes inline below.

Attachments (stubs):
- SOC2_Report_Q1_2027.pdf (Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II report; redacted for customer-specific data)
- pen_test_summary_2026.zip (summary of third-party pen test Q4 2026 + remediation log)
- DPA_redline_v2.docx (our proposed starting DPA redline)

Quick notes:
- SOC2: report covers control environment, change mgmt, access controls, logging; our next audit window is Q3 2027. For procurement, the attached should satisfy initial evidence requests; if you need an SOC 2 bridge letter closer to your June 18 deadline, we can discuss support options.
- Audit logs: we can provide sample log extracts in CSV/JSON and a walkthrough of the schema. Logs are written to immutable S3 with lifecycle/retention policies; we support customer-managed KMS keys (we integrate with AWS KMS and common HSM providers).
- Pen test: summary includes CVSS scores and remediation tickets. We can share ticket IDs and timelines under an NDA if needed.
- DPA: our redline accepts a narrow set of customer demands; highlight what you’d like changed and we’ll try to accommodate.

Next steps (updated):
- Marissa: provide these attachments (done).
- Samira/Tom: review attachments and share legal redlines or questions by June 4.
- Neha: I’ll sync you with Tom for the audit-log technical walkthrough — suggest Tuesday 5/25 or Wednesday 5/26 at 10:00am PT.

If helpful, I can assemble a short one-pager mapping ZenWell requirements to the artifacts attached; happy to do so.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Attachments: SOC2_Report_Q1_2027.pdf, pen_test_summary_2026.zip, DPA_redline_v2.docx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ZenWell SOC 2 discovery — security & DPA follow-up

Marissa / Rishi —

Thanks for the summary, Marissa. I'll take point on the technical walkthrough for ZenWell.

Proposed actions for us internally before the call:
- Prepare a 20-min demo of audit log export (CSV/JSON) and retention configuration UI.
- Pull sample immutable storage policy and short note on KMS key ownership options.
- Prepare anonymized remediation ticket examples from the pen test summary; confirm whether we need an NDA for ticket-level detail.
- Confirm who on infra side (Rishi) can join the 5/25 or 5/26 slot.

Rishi — can you confirm availability 5/25 10:00am PT? If not, suggest an alternate time. Also let me know if we need to redact any ticket-level PII before sharing.

Marissa — I'll also draft a one-pager mapping ZenWell ask -> artifact and share back for your approval before sending.

-Neha
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
